Interface ReloadableRegistry<T extends net.kyori.adventure.key.Keyed>

All Superinterfaces:
Iterable<T>, Registry<T>
@NonExtendable public interface ReloadableRegistry<T extends net.kyori.adventure.key.Keyed> extends Registry<T>
A registry rebuilt from ReloadableProviders on every reload (D5). Reads always see one complete snapshot.
